Join loan origination and performance histories, fit a default hazard model, and compare a higher loan-to-value scenario.

## Scope

Results describe the supplied historical snapshot or a stated simulation. Model fit and scenario estimates are not evidence of performance on new observations. See the project README for the execution record and limitations.

```{r}
source("R/analytics_support.R")
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
load("Data/mortgage_credit.RData")
```

```{r}
tmp <- Data_A[, .(LOAN_ID, OLTV, DTI, PROP_TYP, CSCORE_B)]
```

```{r}
data <- tmp[Data_P,on="LOAN_ID"]
```

```{r}
ZBC_default <- c("02","03","09","15")      
ZBC_prepaid <- c("01")

data <- data[, raw_status := ifelse(
  Zero.Bal.Code %in% ZBC_default, "default",
  ifelse(Zero.Bal.Code %in% ZBC_prepaid, "prepaid", "censored")
)]
```

```{r}
data<-data[
  ,
  final_row := Loan.Age == max(Loan.Age),
  by = LOAN_ID
]
```

```{r}
data<-data[
  ,
  status := ifelse(
    raw_status == "default", "default",
    ifelse(
      raw_status == "prepaid", "prepaid",
      ifelse(final_row, "censored", "active")
    )
  )
]
```

```{r}
data <- data[, start := Loan.Age]
data <- data[, end := Loan.Age + 1]

data <- data[order(LOAN_ID, Loan.Age)]
```

```{r}
data<-data[, event := ifelse(status == "default", 1, 0)]
```

```{r}
data[, .(observations = .N, loans = uniqueN(LOAN_ID))]
```

```{r}
ages <- seq(0,240,24)

data<-data[
  ,
  age.bucket := cut(
    Loan.Age,
    breaks = ages,
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )
]
```

```{r}
data<-data[, EAD := LAST_UPB]
```

```{r}
data<-data[, LGD := 0.10]
```

```{r}
data[, .N, by = status]
```

```{r}
summary(data[, .(CSCORE_B, OLTV, DTI)])
```

```{r}
DefaultModel <- coxph(
  Surv(start, end, status == "default") ~ CSCORE_B + OLTV + DTI + PROP_TYP,
  data = data,
  ties = "efron"
)

DefaultModel
```

```{r}
sim.creditscore <- data[, round(mean(CSCORE_B, na.rm = TRUE))]
sim.oltv        <- data[, round(mean(OLTV, na.rm = TRUE))]
sim.dti         <- data[, round(mean(DTI, na.rm = TRUE))]


sim.age <- data[
  status == "default",
  round(mean(Loan.Age, na.rm = TRUE))
]


data.hypo.default <- data.table(
  LOAN_ID = rep("HYPOTHETICAL", sim.age),
  status  = c(rep("active", sim.age - 1), "default"),
  start   = 0:(sim.age - 1),
  end     = 1:sim.age,

  CSCORE_B = rep(sim.creditscore, sim.age),
  OLTV     = rep(sim.oltv, sim.age),
  DTI      = rep(sim.dti, sim.age),


  PROP_TYP = "SF"
)
```

```{r}
pred <- predict(
  DefaultModel,
  newdata = data.hypo.default,
  type = "expected"
)

data.hypo.default<-data.hypo.default[,h_D := pred]
```

```{r}
data.hypo.default <- data.hypo.default[,H_D := cumsum(h_D), by = LOAN_ID]
data.hypo.default<-data.hypo.default[, H_D_lag := shift(
  H_D,
  n = 1,
  type = "lag",
  fill = 0
), by = LOAN_ID]
data.hypo.default<-data.hypo.default[, S_D_lag := exp(-H_D_lag)]
data.hypo.default<-data.hypo.default[, S_D := exp(-H_D)]
data.hypo.default<-data.hypo.default[, P_D_t := S_D_lag - S_D]
```

```{r}
data.hypo.default2 <- copy(data.hypo.default)

data.hypo.default2<-data.hypo.default2[, OLTV := OLTV + 10]
```

```{r}
pred2 <- predict(
  DefaultModel,
  newdata = data.hypo.default2,
  type = "expected"
)

data.hypo.default2<-data.hypo.default2[,h_D := pred2]
data.hypo.default2 <- data.hypo.default2[,H_D := cumsum(h_D), by = LOAN_ID]
data.hypo.default2<-data.hypo.default2[, H_D_lag := shift(
  H_D,
  n = 1,
  type = "lag",
  fill = 0
), by = LOAN_ID]
data.hypo.default2<-data.hypo.default2[, S_D_lag := exp(-H_D_lag)]
data.hypo.default2<-data.hypo.default2[, S_D := exp(-H_D)]
data.hypo.default2<-data.hypo.default2[, P_D_t := S_D_lag - S_D]
```

```{r}
tail(data.hypo.default2$H_D, 1) / tail(data.hypo.default$H_D, 1)
```

```{r}
exp(coef(DefaultModel)["OLTV"] * 10)
```

```{r}
F1 <- 1 - tail(data.hypo.default$S_D, 1)
F2 <- 1 - tail(data.hypo.default2$S_D, 1)
F1
F2
F2 - F1
```

## Interpretation limits

These are in-sample hazard models. Prepayment is treated as censoring; default-only survival is not a competing-risk cumulative incidence estimate. No held-out calibration or proportional-hazards diagnostics are claimed. Raw loan records are excluded from publication.
